BSc Computer Science and Engineering

This three-year bachelor's programme is taught entirely in English at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science.

Degree
Bachelor of Science
Language of instruction
English
Duration
3 years

Entry requirements for 2027 entry

Applicants must have an IELTS Academic score with an overall band of 6.5, with no individual component below 6.5.

Key dates

Applications for the 2027/2028 academic year open on 1 October 2026. The application deadline is 15 January 2027 at 23:59 CET.
